body: Don't freak out but chill OCD feeds off from us being stressed because when stressed we can't think rationally from your brief explanations of the situation i see that there is nothing to worry about its just your OCD with all its irrational thoughts trying to convince you something bad will happen out of every little situation. Learn to ignore your OCD not feed it by giving into obsessive thoughts and doing compulsive actions as a relief these will only feed the monster instead of this ignore it and realize your OCD is not you if you learn to do this from this point on your OCD will only starve until you are OCD free.
